label: Dondurma
note: Maraş dondurma: milk, salep and sugar, no cream; pounded and stretched, not churned

about.text: Dondurma is the Turkish word for ice cream. Maraş dondurması or dövme dondurma is a Turkish variety associated with the city and province of Kahramanmaraş, known for its elastic texture and distinctive preparation. Traditional Maraş dondurması is made using goat's milk, salep, and sugar.
